Get more with
Synchrony Bank

Whether you're looking for FDIC-insured savings products, great savings rates, or answers and help to start saving smarter, Synchrony Bank gives you more.

MORE EXPERIENCE YOU CAN TRUST.

We're a part of Synchrony—a Fortune 500 company that's been helping consumers reach for what's important for more than 80 years.

MORE DEDICATED TO YOUR FUTURE.

We're an online bank offering FDIC-insured savings products an premium credit solutions with no annual fee. We pass our collective savings on to you—that's the power of "more."

ALWAYS OPEN TO MORE.

We're also the leading provider of private-label credit cards in the United States, so we might already be in your wallet supporting one of your favorite retailers.

What we stand for
We’re proud to say we’ve built a culture that stands for strong values and a shared vision and mission. It’s a core part of our DNA, and a bold declaration of our commitment to do the right thing: for our partners, for our customers, and for our team members.
Our vision
To build a future where every ambition is within reach.
Our mission
Creating financial and technology solutions to move our customers and partners toward their goals, on their terms.
Our values
Our values mark our past, inform our actions every day, and inspire our future.

Security and Protection
The security of your banking and financial information is critical to our mission to help you save smart every day. Here’s part of how we take care of your data:
FDIC-Insured
Your deposit accounts are insured up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each ownership category. Learn more about FDIC insurance.
Security Monitoring
Protecting your financial transactions is of the highest importance to us. We monitor our devices 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for your peace of mind.
